notes: Union does not publish a Somerset-style ArcGIS Hub catalog. County GIS is an HTML5 viewer with a strong as-is disclaimer. Differentiated value is Consumer Affairs lookup, Home Improvement Program semantics, ADRC directory, and Clerk search — not bulk GIS.

sources.source_name: Union County Clerk Public Land Records (UCPA/DocIndex)
geography_fields: indexed by name only; municipality not a primary search key
sources.refresh_method: Interactive name search. No documented REST/export.
sources.terms_notes: Index covers instruments recorded 1977-06-01 through 2026-01-21. Public can view published images (first page). Full-document online viewing requires paid registered searcher ($600/year, up to 5 users). Paper record room holds copies from 1857. Imaging of documents prior to January 1986 is in process and must not be treated as an index gap of zero. Clerk states records are indexed by name only.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not scrape search sessions. Pre-1986 image limitation is separate from index availability.
sources.blocker: No bulk API. Paid registration for full images.
sources.recommended_next_action: Leave as official search. Do not build a parallel index.
sources.semantic: MORTGAGE RECORD != CURRENT BALANCE; LIEN != CONTRACTOR WRONGDOING

sources.source_name: Union County Office of Consumer Affairs
sources.refresh_method: Phone lookup today; OPRA/non-PII extract if granted
sources.terms_notes: Office acts under Consumer Fraud Act against businesses located in Union County. Investigators will check complaints on file. No public bulk history was found.
sources.redistribution_notes: No complainant PII or narratives. Complaint != violation.
sources.recommended_next_action: Submit the drafted non-PII request when a later ticket is ready. Do not scrape.
sources.semantic: COUNTY COMPLAINT != VIOLATION; COUNTY DATA ABSENCE != ZERO

sources.municipality: participating municipalities only; Elizabeth, Linden, Plainfield, Rahway, Union run independent rehab
sources.terms_notes: CDBG-funded deferred loan up to $24,999 as published 2026-01-14. HUD income limits change annually. Contractor registration application exists; no public participant list.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not publish benefit amounts without the page date. Do not call this a county contractor license.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep UNION_COUNTY_HOME_IMPROVEMENT_PROGRAM_PARTICIPANT as the only allowed entity class if a list arrives.

sources.source_name: Union County Senior Home Improvement Grant
sources.terms_notes: Grant capped at $10,000 as published 2026-01-14 for eligible residents ages 62+. Does not have to be repaid. Same income/property rules as HIP.
sources.redistribution_notes: Stale dollar amounts must keep the 2026-01-14 effective/source date.
sources.recommended_next_action: Publish as county program, not as a facility or contractor credential.

sources.terms_notes: County disclaimer: prepared for internal County use, not designed for general public use; no warranty; not a survey; user must independently verify. Parcel/legal-boundary use is not authorized from this product.
sources.redistribution_notes: Thin county GIS. Use NJGIN/NJDEP/FEMA for statewide layers rather than reverse-engineering the viewer.
